description: This file defines the ManyToManyRelationship class which manages metadata for many-to-many relationships within the SuiteCRM system. It includes methods to build subpanel definitions, vardefs, and relationship metadata, extending an abstract relationship class.

classes.name: ManyToManyRelationship
classes.description: A class to manage metadata for a many-to-many relationship, providing methods to build subpanel definitions, vardefs, and relationship metadata.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the relationship with a given definition.

methods.name: buildSubpanelDefinitions
methods.description: Constructs subpanel definitions for the related modules, returning an array of definitions unless only relationship metadata is required.

methods.name: buildVardefs
methods.description: Builds vardefinitions for the relationship, returning an array keyed by module.

methods.name: buildRelationshipMetaData
methods.description: Returns metadata definitions for the relationship, specific to the lhs module.
